title: Jab Sab Kuch Ruk Jaye... 💔
hook_line: Yaadon se baat nahi banti / Kuch dard nigode aise hain, / jeena dubaar kar dete hain.
caption:
Kuch dard aise hote hain jinhe sirf mehsoos kiya ja sakta hai, bataya nahi. 💔

Prithvi Pal Raina ki ye khoobsurat lines un mushkil raahon ke liye jo hum sab kabhi na kabhi tay karte hain. Kya aapne bhi kabhi aisa mehsoos kiya hai?

Save this if it touched your heart.
meaning_note: Ye poem un palon ko darshati hai jab setbacks aur purani yaadein humein andar se todti hain—ek raw aur honest sachai jo har struggle ka hissa hai.
reasons: High demand for 'raw' and 'honest' content (nearly 1M views on similar themes).
Perfectly fits the brand pillar of showing failures and the pain of setbacks.
The hook is emotionally heavy, which drives high engagement/saves.
